die.orientation: portrait in Fig. 2; HBM on the long (W/E) edges
die.source: paper: '< 600 mm2', and A100 (826) is '~40% larger' (=> ~590). Measured on Fig. 2 package photo: die 262 x 292 px, scale from HBM2 stack width 88 px = 7.75 mm -> 23.1 x 25.7 mm = 593 mm2 (using the stack length instead gives 638 mm2; so +-4%).

blocks.source: Jouppi et al., TPU v4: An Optically Reconfigurable Supercomputer..., ISCA 2023, arXiv 2304.01433 (Table 4, Fig. 2), CC BY 4.0: 'SCs are ... only ~5% of the die area'. Location unpublished.
128 MiB CMEM (Table 4); v4i's floorplan says its CMEM/TensorCore arrangement derives from v4's, but v4's own floorplan is unpublished.

edges.note: From the package photo: 2 HBM2 stacks on each long edge of the die.

package.hbm_placement: 2 per side, long axis parallel to the die long edges
